\node[anchor=north west, font=\tiny, text width=5.95cm, align=left] at (0.00, -8.37) {Each panel has three columns: the filer's native line, the behavior-layer role the deterministic cascade assigned, and the law of motion the engine applies to that role. Solid navy box: stored leaf of $z$. Dashed slate box: derived row, recomputed through Apple's own calculation arcs on decode. Gold box with $\cdot$: a product/service member row (dimensional aggregation). Small-caps lines: the filer's section headers. The laws consume one \textbf{driver draw} per Monte Carlo path, the realized set of firm-level driver values (Section~\ref{sec:drivers}) for scenario $x=(\Delta g^{\mathrm{GDP}}, \Delta\pi, \Delta r, z_c, z_d)$: $g_{\mathrm{rev}}$ revenue growth, $\Delta m$ COGS-ratio shift, $g_{\mathrm{opex}}$ opex growth, $\Delta y_A, \Delta c_D$ rate shifts, $g_{\mathrm{div}}$ dividend growth, $b$ buyback factor, noise $\varepsilon_g, \varepsilon_m, \varepsilon_o$; six scenarios, 500 paths each.};
